title: Ball strikes an outside influence
question: Suppose your ball accidentally strikes a dog running across the course. What does the Rule say you must do?

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies, with no penalty.
Replay the shot and add a penalty.
Drop a ball within two club lengths of where it hit the dog.

explanation: If your ball in motion hits an outside influence such as a dog, you must play your ball as it lies with no penalty.

imageAlt: Teen boy golfer watches as his golf ball hits a dog on the fairway.
